svg.text: TABLE REQUEST SYSTEM | Complete wiring schematic
Matches sender.cpp / receiver.cpp. Connections use GPIO labels, not physical header positions.
Power this board by USB. Buttons use INPUT_PULLUP; a press connects the GPIO to GND.
GND pins: all ground symbols in this panel connect to the sender GND.
TABLE UNIT <---------- ESP-NOW wireless link ----------> WAITER UNIT
Power this board by USB. OLED: GME12864-11-12-13 V3.22, SSD1306 I2C, 128 x 64. Follow pin labels.
All ground symbols in this panel connect
to receiver GND, including buzzer supply GND.
Do not connect the buzzer directly to a GPIO.
External 5 V shown feeds ONLY the buzzer.
Do not connect it to ESP32 3V3 or a GPIO.
1. Each LED has its own 330 ohm resistor. LED anode (+) is on the left; cathode (- / flat side) on the right.
2. Four-leg tactile buttons: use contacts that are open when released and connected when pressed.
3. GND symbols are joined within each unit. No wired connection is required between table and watch.
4. GPIO numbers repeat on the two boards. Follow board labels; this is a logical schematic, not a pin-position map.
Parts: 2 ESP32s, 4 buttons, 3 LEDs, 3 x 330 ohm, 1 x 1 kohm, NPN transistor, OLED, active buzzer; 10 kohm optional.
